name: EasyCoupon – Advanced Coupon & Deal for WooCommerce
author: Hive Plugins

sections.description:
EasyCoupon is a powerful and user-friendly WooCommerce plugin designed to boost your sales by providing various coupon-based features. With EasyCoupon, you can easily create auto apply coupon, generate bulk coupons, offer BOGO deals, and create coupon URLs for seamless discounts. This plugin simplifies the entire process of coupon management and enhances the shopping experience for your customers, encouraging higher conversions and repeat purchases.

🚀 Get Pro | 👨‍💻 Docs

Features of EasyCoupon

Free Features:

  1. Bulk Actions: Add or remove coupons from the list in bulk.
  2. Per Page View: Control the number of coupons displayed per page.
  3. Unlimited Add Rule: Create unlimited BOGO rules to enhance promotional offers.
  4. Show Coupon Type: Filter coupons by type, such as percentage discounts, fixed cart discounts, or fixed product discounts.
  5. Discount Amount: Set the discount amount for each BOGO deal.
  6. Products to Buy: Define the products and quantities required for eligibility.
  7. Products to Gift: Select the free or discounted products and their quantities.
  8. Number of Coupons: Generate as many coupons as needed with one click.
  9. Coupon Character Length: Create coupons with character lengths of up to 20.
  10. Discount Type: Select the discount type when generating coupons.
  11. Allow Free Shipping: Enable free shipping with a valid coupon.
  12. Coupon Expiry Date: Set expiration dates for coupons to create urgency.
  13. Usage Restriction: Apply restrictions like minimum and maximum spend, individual use, and exclusion of sale items.
  14. Active Coupon URL: Activate and enable unique URLs for each coupon.
  15. Coupon URL: Copy and share unique coupon URLs.
  16. Force Apply: Automatically apply a single coupon by overriding all others in the cart.

Pro Features:

  1. Prefix: Add a prefix to generated coupons.
  2. Coupon Type: Customize the coupon format to include characters, numbers, or both.
  3. Override URL Code: Customize and override coupon URLs as needed.
  4. Redirect To URL: Redirect users to a specific page when they click a coupon URL.
  5. Success Message: Display a custom success message when coupons are applied via URL.

EasyCoupon – Feature Highlights:

  1. Comprehensive Features: Packed with essential tools to elevate your WooCommerce store’s coupon management.
  2. No Coding Required: Install, activate, and configure without technical expertise.
  3. Time and Cost Efficient: Combines multiple coupon features into one plugin to save time and money.
  4. Multilingual Support: Translation-ready for global audiences, supporting several languages.

Get Started with EasyCoupon

EasyCoupon is the ultimate solution for WooCommerce store owners looking to increase customer retention and drive more sales through flexible, automated, and customizable coupon management. Download and install EasyCoupon today to start boosting your WooCommerce store revenue.

Privacy Policy

EasyCoupon uses Appsero SDK to collect some telemetry data upon user’s confirmation. This helps us to troubleshoot problems faster & make product improvements.

Appsero SDK does not gather any data by default. The SDK only starts gathering basic telemetry data when a user allows it via the admin notice. We collect the data to ensure a great user experience for all our users.

Integrating Appsero SDK DOES NOT IMMEDIATELY start gathering data, without confirmation from users in any case.

Learn more about how Appsero collects and uses this data.
sections.installation:
The easy way:

  1. Go to your WordPress Dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New and search for “EasyCoupon”.
  3. Click Install and then Activate.

The hard way:

  1. Download “EasyCoupon”.
  2. Extract the zip file and upload the contents to the wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
1. What is EasyCoupon, and how does it work?

EasyCoupon is a WooCommerce plugin designed to simplify coupon creation and management with features like bulk coupon generator, BOGO deals, and URL coupons.

2. How can I generate bulk coupons?

Use the bulk coupon generator to create multiple coupons in one go by configuring your settings.

3. Does EasyCoupon support BOGO deals?

Yes, you can create flexible BOGO offers tailored to your products.

4. Can I create URL-based coupons?

Yes, EasyCoupon allows you to generate unique coupon URLs that apply discounts automatically when clicked.

5. Is EasyCoupon compatible with all WooCommerce themes and plugins?

Yes, it works seamlessly with most WooCommerce themes and plugins.
